name: io.github.kawal393/apex-psi-mcp
title: APEX PSI
description: Append-only evidence receipts for AI decisions and documents. Five tools: seal a record into a public ledger, verify any hash against it, check a chain of receipts, generate a citation, and read Bitcoin anchoring status. Anyone can verify, free, with no account. A receipt proves a record existed and was not altered after its timestamp - never that its contents are true.

environmentVariables.description: Optional API base URL override. Default: https://qhtntebpcribjiwrdtdd.supabase.co/functions/v1 (the public APEX PSI notary). Free allowance with no key: 20 operations/minute, 100/day.
environmentVariables.name: APEX_API_BASE

environmentVariables.description: Optional API key. It raises the daily ceiling for a workload; it is never required to seal or to verify, and it cannot change what a receipt is allowed to claim.
environmentVariables.name: APEX_API_KEY
